title: Free-Choice Pronouns in Logic: bár- vs. akár-

sections.title: Universal Quantification in Propositions
sections.content: Both 'bár-' (bárki, bármi, bármelyik) and 'akár-' (akárki, akármi, akármelyik) translate English 'anyone / anything / whichever' in affirmative free-choice propositions ('Bárki beláthatja' = Anyone can see it). However, 'bár-' carries a slightly more elevated, literary, and universalizing tone suitable for formal theorems ('Bármely két pont között...'), whereas 'akár-' stresses arbitrary selection ('Pick any card at random: húzz akármelyik lapot').

sections.title: Self-Referential Paradoxes
sections.content: Thought experiments (gondolatkísérletek) frequently test a rule by plugging an arbitrary or extreme agent ('bárki / akárki') into the rule itself—just as Örkény's clerk realizes that if everyone leaves, the clerk himself becomes the waiting passenger.

sections.title: bár- vs. akár- in Logical Propositions
rows: Whichever path you choose (universal rule), you arrive at the same place.
Akárki megmondhatja, hogy nincs itt sín.
Just anyone at all can tell you that there are no tracks here.
Bármi történjék is, az elv érvényes marad.
Whatever may happen (elevated/formal), the principle remains valid.
Nem akárki képes megoldani ezt a feladványt.
Not just anybody is capable of solving this puzzle.

items.spanish: Bármelyik előfeltevést vizsgáljuk is meg, mindegyik önmagába fordul vissza.
items.english: Whichever presupposition we examine, each one turns back upon itself.

items.spanish: Ez a gondolatkísérlet nem akármilyen logikai csapdát leplez le.
items.english: This thought experiment exposes no ordinary logical trap.

items.spanish: Bárki belép a váróterembe, azonnal a szabályzat részévé válik.
items.english: Anyone who enters the waiting room immediately becomes part of the regulations.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Pay special attention to negated 'nem akárki' (not just anyone = someone extraordinary) and 'nem akármilyen' (not just any kind of = remarkable).
